fresh_executions.scope: Existing bounded synthetic input probes; malformed source and false-ready static builder only. No particle/native solve.

retained_normal_flow: Own CSV/recipe to create/check/run/inspect/analyze/export/view eight commands passed; Decimal wall hit error3.47e-18s, five saved positions error0, failure0, derived source identities match. Retained executed result, not a new simulation this review.

findings.state: confirmed current bug, retained bounded public probe and unchanged owner source
findings.trigger: mesh ID9007199254740992 and raw field ID9007199254740993 at equal coordinates
findings.impact: Raw identities differ but float64 rounds the latter to the former; public importer succeeds and publishes scoped_node_id join. This violates exact identity, although the witness deliberately did not demonstrate a wrong physical field value.
findings.cause: All columns parsed as float before lexical identity is validated; >2**53 guard after conversion cannot see rounding.
findings.required_change: Decode selected node identity exactly before float conversion at field-table owner; preserve scope masking/unselected NaN and coordinate-bijection route.

findings.state: false-ready freshly reproduced; same-input tiny build failure retained and unchanged source
findings.trigger: Canonical three-time-knot temperature plus static velocity on four-node RZ layout supplied to static builder
findings.impact: Public check returns ready, build later performs the small solve then fails IndexError during output generation. No successful wrong completed field is claimed.
findings.cause: Producer checks scalar/vector metadata but not time_s, then static consumers slice the general temporal values array.
findings.required_change: Common builder prepare must resolve static thermal input and reject unsupported time dependence before check/build consumers or solve.

findings.state: columns:null freshly reproduced; other malformed/extra-cell cases retained at identical source
findings.trigger: columns:null / filter:null / missing filter column / invalid lexical ID / extra data cell
findings.impact: Malformed source config/lexical ID can leak internal traceback and exit1; surplus data cell can be ignored and published. columns:null leaves output absent.
findings.cause: Raw nested configuration and row shape used before meaning/type normalization.
findings.required_change: Normalize source spec before filtering, validate header/data arity, translate lexical/domain errors at owner, keep required scientific value checks.

findings.state: bounded failure-injection result retained at identical source; not re-injected this review
findings.trigger: Write interruption while public analyze writes summary JSON
findings.impact: CLI structured exit2 is emitted but partial invalid28-byte JSON remains at final path; retry sees existing target.
findings.cause: Destination is created before complete serialization/write; directory publisher policy is not applied to standalone JSON.
findings.required_change: Serialize then complete temporary write and atomic create-if-absent publication; preserve existing target and cleanup on failure.

criteria.reason: 唯一CLI、四core API、wheelのみの通常利用、生成される編集可能例題とREADME手順が明確。

criteria.name: 自分の入力の組立て
criteria.reason: SI/basis/source authorityと明示mappingは良い。field identityのfloat丸め誤join、source row/configの受入不備が残る。

criteria.name: 検査・エラー回復
criteria.reason: core checkは共通prepareであるが、builder checkのfalse-readyとnested sourceの内部tracebackは利用者の事前検査への期待を損なう。

criteria.name: 結果の再利用・公開
criteria.reason: 元caseなしのcontext、共通cohort、export/view directory公開は良い。単独analysis JSONの中断で部分targetが残りretryを妨げる。

criteria.name: 科学的な解釈の支援
criteria.reason: 数値stuck、computational weight、保存点、checkと精度認定の区別を文書化。resolved model scalar/field roleの説明欠落が残る。

scoring.nature: Subjective engineering usability assessment for documented alpha scope, not probability of correct physics

comparison_to_previous.explanation: Same production code; newly established R15/R16 input assurance evidence broadens review and lowers own-input/check scores. This is not a runtime regression caused by metadata-only retirement commits.

release_judgment.technical_research_alpha: Usable for documented normal paths with informed input preparation and scope checks
release_judgment.general_nonexpert_formal_distribution: Input identity and false-ready defects should be fixed before claiming reliable general own-input operation; source error handling and atomic standalone output also need closure
not_blockers_by_themselves: absence of fullmaterial or GPU when not promised
